title: OpenAI pitches data center power plants as a way to protect nearby areas
script:
OpenAI is launching its Grid Protectors Program to support local electrical grids.
The company will pilot this at a new data center in Effingham County, Georgia.
It commits to freeing up one thousand megawatts during extreme weather or emergencies.
That total capacity is enough to run air conditioners in seven hundred thousand homes.
The move follows rising local opposition to data center energy usage in many regions.
Would you trust a data center to manage your local power supply?
